1: <#
2: .SYNOPSIS
3:     Long-task watchdog: run a command with forced logging + heartbeat state file.
4: 
5: .DESCRIPTION
6:     Wraps any command that may take longer than ~1 minute (build, full test suite,
7:     bulk queries, long orchestration) so it is never silently blocking:
8: 
9:       * writes a JSON state file  .task-state\<Name>.state.json
10:         { name, pid, startTs, lastHeartbeat, status, logPath, exitCode, endTs }
11:       * appends all command output to .task-state\<Name>.log
12:       * every -IntervalSeconds (default 30) prints a heartbeat line
13:         "[watchdog HH:mm:ss] <Name> running <elapsed>s" and refreshes lastHeartbeat
14:       * if nothing is heard for -StallSeconds (default 120) prints
15:         "[watchdog] STALL <Name> no output for <n>s ..."
16: 
17:     Designed to be launched with run_in_background: true so the controller can
18:     poll it via job_output every ~30s.
19: 
20: .PARAMETER Name
21:     Task name (used for default log/state file names).
22: 
23: .PARAMETER Command
24:     The command to execute (a string run via Invoke-Expression, or a scriptblock).
25: 
26: .PARAMETER LogPath
27:     Log file. Default: .task-state\<Name>.log
28: 
29: .PARAMETER StatePath
30:     State JSON file. Default: .task-state\<Name>.state.json
31: 
32: .PARAMETER IntervalSeconds
33:     Heartbeat interval in seconds. Default: 30
34: 
35: .PARAMETER StallSeconds
36:     Seconds without output/heartbeat before a STALL warning. Default: 120
37: 
38: .EXAMPLE
39:     pwsh -NoProfile -File .\dsh\scripts\task-watchdog.ps1 -Name demo `
40:         -Command 'Start-Sleep -Seconds 65; Write-Output done' -IntervalSeconds 10
41: #>
42: [CmdletBinding()]
43: param(
44:     [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
45:     [string]$Name,
46: 
47:     [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
48:     [string]$Command,
49: 
50:     [string]$LogPath,
51: 
52:     [string]$StatePath,
53: 
54:     [int]$IntervalSeconds = 30,
55: 
56:     [int]$StallSeconds = 120
57: )
58: 
59: Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
60: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
61: 
62: # ---- resolve defaults -------------------------------------------------------
63: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($LogPath)) {
64:     $LogPath = Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-Location) '.task-state') ($Name + '.log')
65: }
66: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($StatePath)) {
67:     $StatePath = Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-Location) '.task-state') ($Name + '.state.json')
68: }
69: 
70: $logDir = Split-Path -Parent $LogPath
71: if ($logDir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) {

73: }

75: if ($stateDir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateDir)) {
76:     New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stateDir -Force | Out-Null
